senses.gloss:
शि (न, ञ) शिनोति, शिनुते 5.
c. To
make thin or small; to whet.

शि (शिः-) 2.
m. Shiva; auspicious-
ness; composure.

शी (ल, ङ) शेते 2.
d. To sleep. With
prep. अति, to exceed; अधि, to
abide; सं to doubt.

शी (शीः) 3.
f. Sleep, repose; devo-
tion; tranquillity.

षि (न ञ) सिनोति सिनुते 5.
c. To
tie, bind. Also (ग ञ) सिनाति,

c.
